original_complete_object.claim: HP clamps and zero clears status/evolution-ready; status setter first rejects not-able then normalizes. level validates and sets exp; Battler writes its local prefix before requesting it. Form setter clears ability cache, invokes handler, recalculates and records dex; calc_stats adjusts HP by max-HP delta with its positive minimum behavior. Unknown persistent item input is ignored, whereas Battler normalizes absence and then clears.
original_complete_object.scope: Only cited complete units/explicit text ranges; no whole-foreign-file credit.

actual_complete_meaning: 持久HP钳[0,totalhp]，归0请求heal_status但其蛋守卫保留蛋异常/计数，ready_to_evolve仍清。status setter先拒不可用，再解析并写规范身份。Battler先写本地HP/状态/等级，再调用持久接收者。
等级越界可在本地已改后由持久入口报错；HP持久钳制不回读改写Battler局部值。未知持久物品输入被忽略，Battler解析为空后写穿清除，二者不同。
形态提交先写形态、清能力值缓存，再handler、重算与条件图鉴登记；不清能力索引或forced_form。calc_stats按HP上限差调整且正路径最少1，写穿持久HP；动态form读取在非战斗/非仓库且无forced值时可先提交。
